project_type: Static website (HTML/CSS/JS) hosted on GitHub Pages
build_system: None - static files served directly. Uses 'npx serve . -l 3000' for local development
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npx playwright test' to verify all existing and new tests pass. 2. Manually verify by running 'npx serve . -l 3000' and opening http://localhost:3000 in a browser
setup_instructions: 1. cd /projects/sandbox/instagram_extractor 2. npm install 3. npx playwright install chromium
environment_constraints: No backend server available. All logic must be client-side JavaScript. Instagram APIs are locked down - oEmbed requires auth, pages redirect to login. CORS proxy services are the best available option for fetching data. Network access is available from this sandbox.
contribution_requirements: Create a feature branch, push, and create PR via gh api. Do not push to main directly.
key_patterns: Functions are in script.js with JSDoc comments. Main flow: generatePoster() -> fetchInstagramData(url) -> updatePosterFromData(url). The fetchInstagramData function currently returns empty data. The poster update logic in updatePosterFromData() already handles all UI updates when given data.
directory_structure: Root contains: index.html (main page), script.js (all JS logic), style.css (styling), tests/poster.spec.js (E2E tests), package.json, playwright.config.js, .github/workflows/playwright.yml (CI)
